paragraphs.text: Rosnakht is a kobold warrior from Dominaria .

Rosnakht comes from a long and proud line of kobolds eager to burn, stab, and slash their way across the mountains of the Kher Ridges . After reclaiming Kher Keep from her mother, Rosnakht seeks to do what no other kobold in her lineage has done (not even her legendary ancestor Rohgahh ): kill the draconic false god Prossh , and free her people from his hungry rule.
